profileHelp.title: Help Center
profileHelp.faq1Q: What's the difference between the modes in the Smart Camera Assistant?
profileHelp.faq1A: Standard mode gives general composition advice; Smart Composition measures the subject's proportion in real time and gives voice prompts to move forward/back; Pro mode combines a local scene description with a cloud model to produce a more detailed shooting plan, which takes a bit longer.
profileHelp.faq2Q: Can other people see the photos saved in "My Templates"?
profileHelp.faq2A: No. Templates are tied to your account — only you, once logged in, can view or delete them; other users cannot access them.
profileHelp.faq3Q: How do I enable face login?
profileHelp.faq3A: Go to "Profile - Settings - Face Login", tap to register your face and complete the capture while facing the camera. After that, you can choose "Face Login" on the login page.
profileHelp.faq4Q: Why is there no data in Analysis Records / Environment Records?
profileHelp.faq4A: A record is only created after you actually take a photo and get AI advice on the Selfie Analysis or Environment Analysis page — history is not pre-populated.
profileHelp.faq5Q: How is the day streak at the top of the "Profile" page calculated?
profileHelp.faq5A: Any day on which you perform a selfie analysis, an environment analysis, or save a template counts as active. The streak counts consecutive active calendar days; missing a day resets the count.
profileHelp.faq6A: It's for detecting foreign object debris (FOD) left in railway switch machines: first register a baseline photo for the device, then use three parallel detection paths plus baseline-difference comparison to produce an inspection record with a full evidence trail.
